name: Greek Chicken Tomato-Feta Skillet
why: Seared chicken breasts simmered in a cherry-tomato/Kalamata/feta pan sauce - a pure one-pan skillet saute with no rice/pasta/potato/bread base. Published 491 cal / 30g protein / 16g carbs sits dead-center of the 400-650 band and clears the 25g+ protein identity with carbs half the 35g ceiling; nutrition READ from the page, high confidence. Distinct from catalog Greek chicken, which is all rice/slow-cooker (slow-cooker-greek-chicken-bowls, chicken-gyro/souvlaki rice bowls) - no low-carb Greek skillet exists. Nearly all ingredients map to the board (chicken-breast, olive-oil, lemon-juice, paprika, cherry-tomatoes, white-onion, white-wine, honey, red-pepper-flakes, kalamata-olives, feta, fresh-parsley); only the Greek seasoning blend has no board home - a useful pricer-lane flag. Weigh-and-divide skillet, scales cleanly to 14 servings.
